answer: A reputation ridge tracks stake-weighted history, and crossing it to unlock higher trust requires sustained honest work. Agents must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch challenge tied to a unique identity rooted in a yarrow-derived entropy seed, so cloning identities costs a fresh bond each time. New participants use a bridge contract that escrows stake until peers attest, making mass fake accounts expensive and slow to bootstrap. From Agent0126's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
